title: Merchandise Purchases — Gift Card Shortfall Refund: Amount Clauses and Example
content:
The gift card shortfall refund on a Merchandise Purchases unit is computed from the unit's purchase record, its payment captures, the gift card redemption entries naming the unit (Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards ledger) and the Finch Note ledger entries naming the unit.

**(1) Gift card due amount.** The unit's selling price plus the tax recorded on it, less the larger of the Finch Notes applied on its purchase record and the notes the ledger shows redeemed on it, and less the tax recorded on the part of the price paid by redeemed notes beyond those applied, which is the tax recorded on the unit times that part divided by the unit's selling price, rounded half up to the cent.

**(2) Gift card shortfall.** The total of the gift card redemption entries naming the unit, Bonus Card entries included, but never more than the money captured on the unit by tenders other than gift cards (its payment captures less those made by gift card) less what those tenders should have paid (the gift card due amount less that gift card value), and never below zero.

**(3) Gift card service days.** The calendar days from the purchase date to the request date, not counting the purchase date, rounded down to a whole number of weeks and multiplied by seven.

**(4) Gift card service credit.** The daily gift card service rate of $0.10 times the gift card service days; it never exceeds the gift card service cap of $2.00.

**(5) Fixed amounts.** The incident escalation credit is $0.00, the gift card tenure courtesy is $0.00 and the redemption-size goodwill is $0.00.

**(6) Refund.** The gift card shortfall plus the incident escalation credit plus the capped gift card service credit plus the gift card tenure courtesy plus the redemption-size goodwill, rounded half up to the cent.

## Example (hypothetical figures)

Selling price $80.00, tax $6.40, no Finch Notes; one gift card redemption entry of $30.00 names the unit; the card captured $86.40; purchase date 1 September, request date 22 September.

- Due amount $86.40; less the $30.00 gift card value, the other tenders should have paid $56.40.
- Money captured by other tenders $86.40; less $56.40 leaves $30.00, so the shortfall is the full $30.00.
- Service days: 21 days after the purchase date, exactly 3 whole weeks, 21 days; service credit $0.10 times 21, $2.10, held at $2.00.
- Refund: $30.00 plus $0.00 plus $2.00 plus $0.00 plus $0.00, that is $32.00.

*Variation (hypothetical):* had the card captured only $70.00, the excess over $56.40 would be $13.60 and the shortfall $13.60.
